parts.name: Frame
parts.Basic_description: The frame of the clock is made of plastic and forms the outer circular boundary of the clock.
parts.Functional_description: It provides structural support and holds the glass, surface, and internal components together.
parts.Movement_description: It is a fixed part and does not move during operation.

parts.name: Hand (Minute Hand)
parts.Basic_description: This is the minute hand of the clock, made of lightweight aluminum for smooth rotation.
parts.Functional_description: It indicates the minutes on the clock face by rotating around the center axis.
parts.Movement_description: It rotates continuously around the central pivot driven by the clock mechanism.

parts.name: Hand (Hour Hand)
parts.Basic_description: This is the hour hand of the clock, made of aluminum and shorter than the minute hand.
parts.Functional_description: It indicates the hours on the clock face by rotating around the center axis at a slower rate.
parts.Movement_description: It rotates slowly around the central pivot, completing one revolution every 12 hours.

parts.name: Surface (Dial)
parts.Basic_description: The surface or dial of the clock is a flat circular plate made of plastic with printed numbers or markers.
parts.Functional_description: It provides a readable background for the clock hands and displays the time markings.
parts.Movement_description: It remains stationary and serves as a visual reference for the moving hands.

parts.name: Glass (Cover)
parts.Basic_description: The glass cover is a transparent protective layer made of glass that covers the clock face.
parts.Functional_description: It protects the clock hands and surface from dust and damage while allowing visibility.
parts.Movement_description: It is fixed in place and does not move during operation.
